name: Hearthlift Courier
description: Carry a marked crate through an original terraced voxel garden, using helper crates as climbable steps before delivering it to a glowing hearth. Solve from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage only. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
natural_language: Carry the marked crate to the glowing hearth. Inspect the terraced 3D garden, push helper crates into useful same-height cells, climb their tops, return for the cargo, and carry it through the changed route to the hearth. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original self-contained voxel bridge grounded in IND-068 / Bonfire Peaks: box placement changes climbable height relationships and the marked cargo must reach a visible fire endpoint. No source art, code, levels, or hidden solution is copied.
